title: Per-workflow browser preference
description: Lets the customer pick which browser MCP each workflow uses. Setup defaults to browserbase (easy, cloud). Publishing defaults to chrome-devtools-mcp (Chrome Canary, local, visible — user can watch and intervene). After N successful runs of a workflow with chrome-devtools, mcp-doctor surfaces an opt-in suggestion to upgrade that workflow to browserbase.

defaults.description: Per-workflow browser MCP. Customer-editable. New workflows added here as the plugin evolves.

trust_counts.description: Successful-run counter per workflow. mcp-doctor increments after each successful action. When count >= upgrade_threshold and default is chrome-devtools-mcp, doctor surfaces a one-time suggestion to graduate to browserbase.

upgrade_threshold.description: Suggest browserbase upgrade after this many successful chrome-devtools runs of the same workflow.

user_declined_upgrade.description: Workflows where the user explicitly declined the browserbase-upgrade suggestion. Doctor stops asking.
